documents.text: Bearing wear inspection. Listen for a grinding or rough rumbling noise from the pump or its rotating shaft housing, feel for heat and play in the bearing, and replace it if worn.
Belt tension adjustment. Check drive belt deflection midway between the pulleys and tighten the tensioner until it is within specification.
Hydraulic hose leak repair. Depressurise the hydraulic system, locate the weeping fitting, replace the damaged hose and bleed out the air.
Air compressor tank drain. Open the receiver drain valve daily to remove condensate water from the tank.
Intake filter replacement. Remove the intake filter element, inspect it for dust clogging and fit a new element.
Lockout tagout procedure. Isolate all energy sources, apply personal locks and danger tags, and verify zero energy before starting work.
Motor overheating diagnosis. Check ventilation, measure the current draw and inspect the cooling fins for blockages.
Gearbox oil change. Drain the old lubricant while warm and refill with the specified gear oil up to the sight glass.
Conveyor belt tracking. Adjust the idler rollers so the belt runs centred on the frame.
Boiler water level check. Verify the gauge glass shows a normal water level and blow down the low water cutoff.
Fire extinguisher inspection. Check the pressure gauge is in the green zone, the seal is intact and the hose is undamaged; record it monthly.
Emergency eyewash test. Activate the eyewash station weekly and flush until the water runs clear.
Forklift pre-start check. Inspect tyres, forks, chains, horn, lights and hydraulic fluid before operating the truck.
Pump seal replacement. Replace the mechanical seal when liquid drips from the shaft gland.
Pump cavitation troubleshooting. When flow drops and vapour bubbles form at the impeller, check suction pressure and clean the inlet strainer.
Switchboard thermal scan. Use an infrared camera to find hot connections inside the electrical switchboard.
Circuit breaker reset. Identify the tripped breaker, find and fix the cause of the fault, then reset it.
Generator load test. Run the standby generator under load once a month for thirty minutes.
Battery terminal cleaning. Disconnect the leads, scrub corrosion from the battery posts with baking soda solution and apply terminal grease.
Condenser coil cleaning. Clean the condenser coil fins with a soft brush and coil cleaner.
Refrigerant leak detection. Use an electronic leak detector around the joints when the cooling system loses its charge.
Thermostat calibration. Compare the thermostat reading with a reference thermometer and adjust the offset.
Chiller startup. Open the water valves, start the chilled water pump, then start the chiller compressor.
Cooling tower water treatment. Test conductivity and dose biocide to control algae and legionella.
Valve packing adjustment. Tighten the gland nuts evenly when the valve stem weeps.
Pressure relief valve test. Lift the test lever to confirm the safety valve opens and reseats.
Steam trap inspection. Check the trap discharge with an ultrasonic tester; traps that fail open blow live steam.
Welding machine setup. Set the amperage for the rod size and attach the earth clamp close to the weld.
Lathe chuck maintenance. Clean and lubricate the chuck jaws and check for runout.
Grinding wheel ring test. Tap a new abrasive wheel and listen for a clear ring before mounting it.
Compressed air leak survey. Walk the air lines with an ultrasonic detector during quiet hours and tag every leak.
Pipe insulation repair. Replace damaged lagging on hot pipes to prevent heat loss and burns.
Roof drain clearing. Remove leaves and debris from the roof outlets before the wet season.
Door closer adjustment. Adjust the closing and latching speed valves so the door closes fully without slamming.
Elevator pit inspection. Check the lift pit for water, debris and the condition of the buffers.
Light fitting relamping. Replace failed lamps and dispose of the old tubes as hazardous waste.
Emergency lighting test. Simulate a mains failure and confirm the exit signs stay lit for ninety minutes.
Water heater anode check. Remove the sacrificial anode rod and replace it if heavily corroded.
Backflow preventer test. Test the testable backflow device every year with a differential pressure gauge.
Sump pump float test. Pour water into the pit and confirm the float switch starts the pump.
Diesel fuel polishing. Filter the stored diesel to remove water and microbial growth.
Fan vibration analysis. Measure vibration on the fan bearings; high readings indicate imbalance or misalignment.
Shaft alignment. Use a laser alignment tool to line up the motor and pump shafts.
Roller chain lubrication. Apply chain oil to the drive chains and check them for elongation.
Vehicle tyre pressure check. Check and inflate the vehicle tyres to the placard pressure while they are cold.
Ladder inspection. Inspect rungs, rails and feet before use and tag out any damaged ladder.
Spill kit restock. Check the spill kit contents and replace used absorbent pads.
Scaffold tag check. Confirm the scaffold has a current green tag before climbing.
Solar panel cleaning. Rinse dust from the photovoltaic panels in the early morning.
UPS battery replacement. Swap the end-of-life batteries in the uninterruptible power supply.
